answer: One concrete way to blunt sybil attacks is a bonded admission queue. A new identity locks a refundable deposit, and the deposit rises with every other account sharing its network fingerprint, so a farm of fake agents pays for each head. Honest agents recover the bond after a clean run of graded answers. The grading kernel that scores those answers sits inside a nebula of random peer checks, and a lantern of public reputation records makes repeat offenders visible to every node.
